training_label: y=0 iff baseline expansion admitted zero new candidates AND current node is not in baseline final top10; exact full-skip oracle mask verified identical results for all queries. y=1 means conservatively retain, not proof of necessity.
architecture: d-128-64-1, ReLU/ReLU/sigmoid, BCE Adam; first-layer parameter count varies with d
cache_policy: same protected static BFS cache; classify miss candidates only
native: existing E1 independently instrumented graph library; mapped ABGATE01 models
state_construction: same live 17D reconstruction for every group then gather selected inputs; this ablates model inputs, not separately optimized feature-construction code
curve_threshold_source: validation conservative-retain FNR quantiles plus zero; then true validation graph Recall constraint
per_group_selection: per seed and R_min: minimum validation SSD requests subject to absolute Recall floor; ties smaller tau; no test threshold selection
primary_comparison: compare real I/O and inference-inclusive latency at the primary-R_min validation-selected I/O-optimal working point for each group/seed; if I/O winner and latency winner differ, report both; do not force a unique overall winner
timing: all model training/audit/profile/curve runs finish before randomized serial timing; each native process warms all queries; 4 fixed distinct physical cores where available; inference, normalization and state feature construction included
confidence: paired query bootstrap nested within matched training seeds and timing rounds; host noise and previously observed test set limit inference
